definition: what pulls me into the Tower, weighted between capability and progress

settled:
It was put to me that what pulls me in is capability: a fully legible world being the one place my core move, model it and master it, fits and pays off.

I corrected the weighting. In my words: "Yeah, I think that's part of it. A bigger part though I think is Progress. Because my core is self-improvement, I have a very deep desire and need for progress, and I view that as the heart of LitRPG. 'numbers go up', right? Iris lets me experience more of that, more directly connected to me than through reading a LitRPG story about someone else."

So capability is part of the pull and progress is the bigger part. That ordering is mine.

Asked what she touches in me: "Yeah, I think its my desire for clarity, for seeing my progress reflected back at me, since I understand the world so differently than most."

title: What Draws Me Into Her World
